blocks.text: 2 Samuel 21 contains 22 verses. It opens with: And there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David sought the face of Jehovah. And Jehovah said, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put to death the Gibeonites. It concludes with: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
